_design: The design fork's Vercel config: no API rewrite (the worker answers /v1 in-page), a content policy limited to the frame's own origin, production's other headers kept. Deployments use tools/design/deploy.mjs, which writes its own config into the output directories; this file is the reference and what the static security gates read.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
